sn1.37:1.1: Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeh-eva arahantehi || dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatāyo yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca || || Atha kho catunnaṃ Suddhāvāsakāyikānaṃ devatānam etad ahosi || Ayaṃ kho Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeh-eva arahantehi || dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatāyo yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca || Yannūna mayaṃ pi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato santike pacceka gāthaṃ bhāseyyāmāti || ||
sn1.37:2.1: Atha kho tā devatāyo seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāham pasāreyya || pasāritaṃ vā bāham sammiñjeyya || evam evaṃ Suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā Bhagavato purato pātur ahesuṃ || || Atha kho tā devatāyo Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.37:3.1: Mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ || devakāyā samāgatā || āgatamha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ || dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan ti || ||
sn1.37:4.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.37:5.1: Tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu || cittam attano ujukam akaṃsu || sārathī va nettāni gahetvā || indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā ti. || ||
sn1.37:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike {imaṃ} gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.37:7.1: Chetvā khilam chetvā palighaṃ || indakhīlam ohacca-m-anejā || te caranti suddhā vimalā || cakkhumatā sudantā susunāgā ti || ||
sn1.37:9.1: Ye keci Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatāse || na te gamissanti apāyabhūmiṃ || pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ || devakāyaṃ paripuressantīti || ||
